gloss: doctor in charge; attending physician; primary care doctor

definitions.gloss: doctor in charge (of a patient); attending physician
definitions.explanation: The doctor specifically responsible for a particular patient's care in a hospital or clinic. This is the physician the patient sees regularly for that condition and who coordinates their treatment.

examples.japanese: {担当医|たんとうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: To consult with the attending physician.

examples.japanese: {担当医|たんとうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりました→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: My doctor in charge has changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{担当医|たんとうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please ask the attending physician about the surgery.

examples.japanese: {担当医|たんとうい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a detailed explanation of the test results from my attending physician.

notes:
Literally "the doctor in charge," formed from ⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ (being in charge of) + {医|い} (doctor). This is the standard term used in Japanese hospitals when referring to a specific patient's physician.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {担当医|たんとうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult with the attending physician
- {担当医|たんとうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask the attending doctor
- {担当医|たんとうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to have a change of attending physician
- {担当医|たんとうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: the doctor in charge (polite)
- {担当医|たんとうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧: instructions from the attending physician

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主治医|しゅじい}→主治医：11465_shujii⟧: primary care physician — emphasizes a longer-term relationship; the doctor a patient regularly relies on
- ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧: physician — a formal general term for doctors
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: doctor (as address term) — how patients actually address a doctor in conversation
- ⟦かかりつけ{医|い}→かかりつけ医：22454_kakaritsukei⟧: family doctor; regular doctor — the doctor a family or individual habitually visits, similar to a general practitioner

USAGE:
{担当医|たんとうい} emphasizes the assignment of a specific doctor to a specific case, so it is common in hospitals where a patient is assigned a doctor upon admission. ⟦{主治医|しゅじい}→主治医：11465_shujii⟧ overlaps in meaning but is used more for ongoing care relationships.
